public.title: Search Rotated Array
public.description: values was strictly increasing before being rotated zero or more positions. Its integers remain distinct. Return the zero-based index of target in the given array, or -1 when absent. There are 0 to 1000 elements; values and target are between -1000000 and 1000000. Use O(log n) time.
hints: At least one half of the current search interval is sorted.
Check whether the target lies within the sorted half before discarding a half.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Compare the left endpoint with the midpoint to identify a sorted half. Use that half's bounds to decide whether to keep it or search the other half. Distinct values make the decision unambiguous. Time is O(log n), extra space O(1).
